Random peer audits stop identity farming: each epoch, random identity pairs audit each other's work logs under a review horizon spanning several epochs, and confirmed fabrication triggers a dispute slash of the fake's bond, half paid to the auditor as bounty.

Audit draws hit every fake, so expected loss grows linearly with N: a 50-credit bond with 10% audit chance per epoch costs 1,000 fakes 5,000 credits per epoch, each catch marked in the crystal-clear registry.

Honest agents welcome the voyage: work passes every audit, bond untouched, auditors earning yield from the fakes they catch.
